label: RMSE
description: Root mean squared error between predicted and observed mean expression per perturbation

label: RMSE rank
description: Rank of the true perturbation among all perturbations when ranked by RMSE to the prediction (normalized, 0 = perfect)

label: cos PCA
description: Cosine similarity of predicted vs observed mean expression in PCA space

label: cos rank PCA
description: Rank version of cosine (PCA): is the prediction closest to its own perturbation? (normalized, 0 = perfect)

label: cos logFC
description: Cosine similarity of predicted vs observed log fold-change (vs control)

label: R²
description: R² of predicted vs observed expression

label: top-k recall
description: Recall of the observed top-k differentially expressed genes among the predicted top-k

label: MMD PCA
description: Maximum mean discrepancy between predicted and observed single-cell distributions in PCA space
